name: RenameFileNode
label: Rename File(s)
description: Renames one or more files using various schemes: set new name, add/remove/replace text, change extension, add datetime stamp, or sequential numbering. Supports wildcard patterns and multiple paths separated by semicolons.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: FilesToRename
fields.label: Source file path(s)
fields.description: One or more file paths to rename, separated by semicolons. Supports wildcards (e.g., 'C:\Data\*.txt;C:\Logs\report_*.csv').

fields.name: RenameScheme
fields.label: Rename scheme
fields.description: The renaming strategy to apply. Default: Set new name.

selectOptions.label: Set new name
selectOptions.description: Sets a completely new name for the file.

selectOptions.label: Add text
selectOptions.description: Prepends or appends text to the existing filename.

selectOptions.label: Remove text
selectOptions.description: Removes a specified substring from the filename.

selectOptions.label: Replace text
selectOptions.description: Replaces a specified substring in the filename with new text.

selectOptions.label: Change extension
selectOptions.description: Changes the file extension to a new value.

selectOptions.label: Add datetime
selectOptions.description: Appends or prepends a formatted timestamp to the filename.

selectOptions.label: Make sequential
selectOptions.description: Renames files with sequential numbers (e.g., Invoice_001, Invoice_002).

fields.name: KeepExtension
fields.label: Keep original extension
fields.description: When true, preserves the original file extension regardless of the rename scheme. Default: false.

fields.name: IfExistsAction
fields.label: If file exists
fields.description: Action to take when the target filename already exists. Default: Do nothing (skip).

selectOptions.label: Do nothing
selectOptions.description: Skips the file if it already exists.

selectOptions.label: Overwrite
selectOptions.description: Deletes the existing file and moves the new file.

fields.name: NewFileName
fields.label: New file name
fields.description: The new name for the file (without extension if 'Keep original extension' is true). Example: 'monthly_report'.

fields.name: TextToAdd
fields.label: Text to add
fields.description: The text to prepend or append to the existing filename. Example: '_backup'.

fields.name: AddTextPosition
fields.label: Text position
fields.description: Whether to insert the text before or after the filename. Default: After name.

fields.name: TextToRemove
fields.label: Text to remove
fields.description: The exact text to remove from the filename. Example: '_draft' removes '_draft' from 'report_draft.txt'.

fields.name: TextToReplace
fields.label: Text to find
fields.description: The exact text in the filename to be replaced. Example: 'old' in 'old_report.txt'.

fields.name: ReplaceWith
fields.label: Replace with
fields.description: The replacement text. Example: 'new' replaces 'old' → 'new_report.txt'.

fields.name: NewExtension
fields.label: New extension
fields.description: The new file extension including the leading dot. Example: '.pdf', '.bak'.

fields.name: UseCustomDateTime
fields.label: Use custom datetime
fields.description: When true, allows selecting a custom datetime source instead of the current system time.

fields.name: DatetimeSource
fields.label: Datetime source
fields.description: Choose between current system time or a custom datetime value. Default: Current datetime.

selectOptions.label: Custom datetime
selectOptions.description: Uses a custom datetime value (not yet implemented).

fields.name: AddDateTimePosition
fields.label: Datetime position
fields.description: Whether to place the datetime stamp before or after the filename. Default: After name.

fields.name: DateTimeSeparator
fields.label: Datetime separator
fields.description: Character placed between the filename and datetime stamp. Default: Underscore (_).

fields.name: DateTimeFormat
fields.label: Datetime format
fields.description: The .NET datetime format string. Examples: 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss' → '20250520_143022', 'yyyy-MM-dd' → '2025-05-20'. Default: 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'.

fields.name: BaseFileName
fields.label: Base file name
fields.description: The base name used for sequential renaming. If empty, the original filename is used. Example: 'Invoice'.

fields.name: AddNumberPosition
fields.label: Number position
fields.description: Whether to place the sequential number before or after the base name. Default: After name.

fields.name: StartNumber
fields.label: Start number
fields.description: The first number in the sequence. Default: 1.

fields.name: IncrementBy
fields.label: Increment by
fields.description: The step value between sequential numbers. Example: 5 produces 1, 6, 11, etc. Default: 1.

fields.name: NumberSeparator
fields.label: Number separator
fields.description: Character placed between the base name and sequential number. Default: Underscore (_).

fields.name: UsePadding
fields.label: Pad with zeros
fields.description: When true, pads the sequential number with leading zeros (e.g., 001, 002). Default: false.

fields.name: MinDigits
fields.label: Minimum digits
fields.description: The minimum number of digits when zero-padding is enabled (e.g., 3 → 001, 002). Default: 3.

fields.name: RenamedFiles
fields.label: Renamed files
fields.description: Returns the list of new full paths of all successfully renamed files.
